name: Cloudflare R2

evidence.files: C02: hosted object storage for unstructured data is the primary role; F05: S3-compatible API

line: S3-compatible object storage with no egress fees.

free.text: Free each month: 10 GB-month, 1M writes, 10M reads

files.math: (100 GB − 10 GB free) × $0.015 a GB a month. 100,000 writes and 1 million reads fit within the free allowances. Outbound data (egress) costs $0.
